summary.text: Alexandra Thomas is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent William Buckbee (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
She also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Alexandra Thomas lost to Buckbee in the 2022 general election, 61.9 percent to 38.1 percent, and again in 2024, 62.6 percent to 37.4 percent.
